record_scope_reconstruction: 25 April 2023 migrant blockade on Panamericana Sur road access between Santa Rosa and Chacalluta was cleared the same day.

source_checks.finding: RPP 25 April body describes seated migrants blocking road, police human line and clearance. Ten days stranded is not ten days of road closure.
